

== Previous Wiki identifier ==
The previous Wiki article recorded <code>2_31e1</code>. It is retained in the history and as a navigation alias, not as an implemented blueprint identifier in the checked release. The source trace at <code>f9d36dd896d5bc1f9f0d32cc2232c75d42919da0</code> found no mapping for this identifier; TextState does not accept an <code>e1</code> suffix, and the checked loader consequently reaches integer parsing of <code>31e1</code>. This is a source-level identifier check, not a runtime gameplay finding.<ref>[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/f9d36dd896d5bc1f9f0d32cc2232c75d42919da0/src/gemp-swccg-common/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/common/TextState.java TextState]; [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/f9d36dd896d5bc1f9f0d32cc2232c75d42919da0/src/gemp-swccg-logic/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/game/SwccgCardBlueprintLibrary.java blueprint loader]; [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/f9d36dd896d5bc1f9f0d32cc2232c75d42919da0/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/blueprintMapping.txt explicit blueprint mappings].</ref>

== Book and corrected image wording ==
The 2023 book on page 107 says "If just fired at a planet". The February 2023 preserved image has that wording; the July image changes this clause to "If just fired at a system". The official PC repository commit is explicitly titled "Commence Recharging fix" and records both author and committer timestamps as 2023-07-03T01:18:07Z.<ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=107 2023 Advanced Rulebook], Appendix A, page 107; [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/fbf0206085c8e14898862f7cae6376170c3a0ff9 Commence Recharging fix], official PC Holotable repository, committed 3 July 2023 at 01:18:07 UTC.</ref> The book cover establishes the 2023 edition but not an exact publication day. Its internal PDF timestamps are not used to establish publication order. A separately dated formal announcement was not located in the bounded checked sources. This discrepancy does not change the literal text of either historical source or imply an engine change.
